name: Connection Guard
relationship: Maintained by the authors of this benchmark. Conflict of interest; see METHODOLOGY.md section 1.

shipped.note: As downloaded. operation.mode is OBSERVE: decisions are logged, nobody is refused.

enforce.note: Single documented enforcement switch (config.yml comment and README: OBSERVE first, then ENFORCE).

proxycheck_key.note: enforce + the free ProxyCheck key through the product's documented key field (same key for every product).

free_keys.note: Adds the free ProxyCheck and VPNAPI keys through the product's documented key fields.

documented_failure_policy: failure-policy.vpn: OPEN and failure-policy.geo: OPEN by default (admit when no provider can decide). lookup.deadline-ms 5000.
telemetry: Connection Guard Cloud heartbeat to api.connectionguard.net (blocked at network level for every product's telemetry)
list_sources_note: Lists the shipped configuration downloads (from its generated config); used only for the circularity table.
